card.fires_on: Words inside physics law statements, just before the result such as zero, equal, or same. Seen in explanations of pulleys, work, forces and motion.

modes.label: Equilibrium and force rules

modes.label: Work and energy equations

modes.example: The work is given by the force<< times>> the distance moved.
